thread:
maya: quick async check-in — onboarded model sunbird-v2 (quant4) to staging and ran the standard eval suite. saw ~7% drop on the customer-sentiment promptset vs llama3 baseline, primarily in negation cases. PR #458 includes a tokenizer detokenize tweak I pushed this morning. can someone glance at the PR and also the sample outputs below? pinging @evalbot for traces.

kevin: can take a look in ~15–20m :eyes:

jordan: on call for the next hour, can review after that. if it's urgent, drop a comment on the PR and I'll prioritize.

sarah: can you paste one failing example? makes it easier to reason about prompt/template vs model issue.

maya: sure — sample pair from eval run:

```
PROMPT: "Classify customer sentiment: 'I don't think I'd recommend this.'"
GROUND_TRUTH: negative
SUNBIRD_V2_OUTPUT: "The customer seems satisfied overall."
Llama3_baseline: "The customer is unhappy and would not recommend."
```

maya: note the output flips negation. most failures look like this pattern where negation + contraction appears. also attached short CSV to the PR with 18 failing cases.

evalbot: [trace report] batch_id=20260318-77, latency spike at step=eval-epoch-3, prefixes cached=false. logs: /staging/evals/2026-03-18/20260318-77.log

kevin: looked at PR diff for detokenize. small bug: when token list starts with apostrophe token, we collapse incorrectly — gives "think'd" -> detokenizes to "think d" causing model to lose negation signal in some contexts. i'll write a tiny patch.

maya: thanks. i can test a quick patch if you want me to push a branch. also: i tried switching to quant-profile B earlier (more aggressive) — reverted to default for current eval because I suspected quantization, but regressions persisted.

jordan: heads-up — eval infra showed a batching config change yesterday (max_batch_size bumped to 64 for staging) and that caused some prefix ordering changes in the runtime; i'll roll that back for the staging queue in 20m to rule it out.

sarah: question: could this be a prompt degradation due to new prompt-normalizer in the scoring step? we added lowercasing + punctuation strip a week ago.

maya: possible. these failing prompts include punctuation and contractions. i'll run a small ablation: eval with normalizer off vs on, and post outputs to the PR.

kevin: tiny note on PR — please add a unit test covering the apostrophe edge-case. saves future regressions.

maya: will add test + push patch branch in ~30m.

dev-deploy-bot: rollback staging/batching -> max_batch_size=32 completed by @jordan at 1773800400 :shipit:

jordan: rolled back as above. watching metrics. if things improve we'll re-run the snapshot eval.

evalbot: re-run queued: batch_id=20260318-77b started. ETA ~8m.

devex: heads-up for docs: if detokenize fix lands, we should add a line in the model-onboarding checklist about apostrophe token handling for tokenizers. small PR later.

kevin: re: code, pushed a small fix to kevin/detok-apostrophe; unit test included.

maya: pulling and running now. will comment on PR with before/after samples. thanks all.

sarah: if the ablation shows the normalizer causes noise, maybe we should gate it behind a model flag (opt-in normalization).

maya: noted. putting that in the follow-up ticket. thanks team :pray:
